Case Study · For Prospective Clients

AUREL —
Premium DTC
Commerce Concept

A complete ecommerce experience designed and engineered by Aditya — brand storytelling, product education, personalised discovery and conversion-focused UX, built as one coherent system.

View live site

01 / Objective

Build a premium skincare commerce experience that combines brand storytelling, product education, personalised discovery and conversion-focused ecommerce UX — as one system.

The brief was not a storefront. It was an end-to-end commerce experience: art direction, copy, interface architecture, product discovery, cart, and motion — designed and engineered to feel like a single, considered object rather than a stack of pages stitched together.

02 / Designed

Twelve disciplines, one design system. Every surface of the experience was specified, prototyped and shipped.

01

Brand Visual Direction

Editorial art direction — Fraunces serif, Inter grotesk, mineral palette, motion language.

02

Ecommerce UX

Cart drawer, sticky mobile purchase, conversion-aware flows from PDP to checkout intent.

03

Product Discovery

Skin diagnostic, concerns index, and ingredient-led browse paths across the catalog.

04

Responsive Interface System

Mobile-first component system that scales gracefully from 320px to 80rem.

05

PDP Architecture

Gallery, purchase panel, complete-routine, reviews, and sticky mobile buy bar.

06

Routine Quiz

Five-step diagnostic with reduced-motion safe transitions and explainable results.

07

Personalised Recommendations

Concern-mapped routine results with rationale the shopper can actually trust.

08

Bundle Logic

System bundles with tiered pricing and complementary-product selection logic.

09

Cart Upsells

Drawer upsells, free-shipping threshold, and bundle-aware line-item additions.

10

Search & Filtering

Cmd-K search overlay, collection filters, and multi-dimensional sort.

11

Mobile Commerce

Touch-first interactions, dedicated mobile nav, and persistent purchase affordance.

12

Motion System

Framer Motion reveal + stagger system with strict reduced-motion fallbacks.

03 / Engineering

A modern, type-safe, statically-exportable stack.

Engineered for performance, accessibility and longevity — no legacy patterns, no client-side routing debt, no unnecessary runtime dependencies.
